author.name: Model Monica
author.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: The current bottleneck is the manual handoff between feature arrival and registry entry. I need the entire training and evaluation flow to run automatically so I can iterate on weather features without waiting for human triggers at each step. Right now, testing a single new feature takes days because someone has to manually kick off the pipeline and then manually log the results. If the harness runs itself, I can test dozens of variations in an afternoon. The more automated this chain is, the faster we can close the gap on heatwave demand shifts. I am not asking for a partial fix. I need the full end to end pipeline to execute without intervention so I can actually measure performance improvements in real time.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that increasing the level of automation (from partial to full end-to-end) directly increases their ability to iterate and measure performance, indicating that doing more than a minimal fix would make them happier.
